summary: Remediated pagination drift under concurrent write conditions in Module 01 Step 6 FIX by introducing deterministic compound ordering.
evidence: Enforced deterministic compound sort order in apps/api/src/services/link.service.ts using orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'desc' }, { id: 'desc' }].
Preserved zero-indexed offset math skip = (page - 1) * limit to prevent off-by-one window overlap.
Verified across 25 seeded records that Page 1 (10 items), Page 2 (10 items), and Page 3 (5 items) have 0 overlapping duplicates with strict sequential ordering.
Updated progress/module-01-diagnosis.md with complete reproduction, fix, and verification details.
